description: UGA — strong GA in-state applicant, RD (SAME state as GA Tech, but mid-selectivity → DAMPED boost)
rationale: The intra-state heterogeneity sentinel, now on REAL published data (2026-05-31 in-state fill). UGA's official CDS 2024-25 residency table gives in-state 46.98% / overall 37.92% = 1.24× — so the engine's PRIMARY path uses that directly (not the flagship-ratio proxy). Full-engine result ≈ 0.66 (anchor 0.38 × geo 1.24 × this strong profile's stat boost ~1.4×). Guardrail [0.58, 0.75] is a two-sided trap: the OLD fallback damping (1.58×) would give ~0.84 (caught above) and neutral would give ~0.53 (caught below), so it locks the data-grounded value against both. Contrast with same-state Georgia Tech (full 2.36× at 14% selectivity) proves one state value can't fit both — real per-school data resolves it.
